parsed.summary: The proposed patch changes the subclass check to use `issubclass` instead of direct membership, which should resolve the issue with `DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD` subclasses.

issues.description: The patch uses `issubclass` with `self._subclasses`, which is a tuple of classes. This will always return `False` because `issubclass` expects a class as the second argument, not a tuple of classes. This change is incorrect and will not fix the issue.
